title: Ballet Ballet Dance Studio
specs: Founded by Jiyan Dai, former principal dancer of Texas Ballet Theater and internationally awarded ballet artist
Accredited by the Royal Academy of Dance (RAD) and RAD Dance Exam Center
Offers ballet training for all ages and various dance styles including modern, jazz, Chinese, and Oriental dance
Students have won multiple awards at Youth America Grand Prix and other competitions
gap: No pricing information for classes or programs
blurb: Ballet Ballet Dance Studio offers ballet training courses for all age groups, from infants and toddlers to adults, including professional ballet fundamentals, technique, and artistic expression. The school is accredited by the Royal Academy of Dance (RAD) and provides high-quality ballet training and guidance.
